kernels.definition: Human anatomy and physiology organizes body structure from chemical components to cells, tissues, organs, organ systems, and the organism, so students can connect form to function across scales.

definitionAnchor.quote: Life processes of the human body are maintained at several levels of structural organization

facts.text: A cell is the smallest independently functioning unit of a living organism.

anchor.quote: A cell is the smallest independently functioning unit of a living organism

facts.text: Organs are anatomically distinct structures made of two or more tissue types.

anchor.quote: An organ is an anatomically distinct structure of the body composed of two or more tissue types

kernels.definition: Homeostasis is the maintenance of stable internal conditions, usually through negative-feedback loops that detect a deviation from a set point and activate a response that reverses it.

definitionAnchor.quote: Negative feedback is a mechanism that reverses a deviation from the set point

facts.text: A set point is the physiological value around which the normal range fluctuates.

anchor.quote: A set point is the physiological value around which the normal range fluctuates

facts.text: A feedback loop includes a sensor, a control center, and an effector.

anchor.quote: An effector is the component in a feedback system that causes a change to reverse the situation and return the value to the normal range

kernels.definition: The four broad tissue categories are epithelial, connective, muscle, and nervous tissue, each with structures and functions that support body organization.

definitionAnchor.quote: they are organized into four broad categories of tissues: epithelial, connective, muscle, and nervous

facts.text: Histology studies tissue appearance, organization, and function under the microscope.

anchor.quote: histology, the microscopic study of tissue appearance, organization, and function

facts.text: Tissue cells share morphological features and an orderly arrangement that supports tissue function.

anchor.quote: share morphological features and are arranged in an orderly pattern that achieves the tissue's functions

kernels.definition: The integumentary system includes the skin and accessory structures; skin has epidermal and dermal layers that support protection and communication.

definitionAnchor.quote: The skin and its accessory structures make up the integumentary system

facts.text: The skin has two main layers: the epidermis and dermis.

anchor.quote: The skin is composed of two main layers: the epidermis

facts.text: The epidermis is made of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium.

anchor.quote: The epidermis is composed of keratinized, stratified squamous epithelium

kernels.definition: The skeletal system is made of bones and cartilage and supports the body, enables movement, protects organs, produces blood cells, and stores minerals and fat.

definitionAnchor.quote: supports the body, facilitates movement, protects internal organs, produces blood cells, stores and releases minerals and fat

facts.text: Bone is hard, dense connective tissue that forms most of the adult skeleton.

anchor.quote: Bone, or osseous tissue, is a hard, dense connective tissue

facts.text: Bones facilitate movement by providing attachment points for muscles.

anchor.quote: Bones also facilitate movement by serving as points of attachment for your muscles
